subtitle: This platform is for locating and controlling your devices.
setup_instruction_3: on your mobile device. Then use the app to register an account on FMD Server.
login_slow: Password hashing appears to be slow. This usually happens when JavaScript JIT is disabled in your browser. Either enable JIT, or be patient and wait up to 5 minutes.

register.token_placeholder: Registration token (if the server has one)
register.hint: An owner account shows all your devices on one map. It stores the keys of your devices, encrypted with this password: choose a strong password that you use nowhere else.
register.bad_name: This name cannot be used: it is taken or contains characters that are not allowed (letters, digits, - and _ only).
